Petra Svoboda is a frontend engineer whose work consistently elevates the quality and efficiency of our consulting projects. As a peer, I’ve observed her technical rigor and how she approaches challenges with a blend of curiosity and precision.  

Her expertise in React and TypeScript is foundational to our team’s architecture. She architected a scalable component library that reduced duplication across projects by 40%, and her TypeScript typings cut runtime errors in third-party integrations by half. Node.js and REST API design are part of her daily workflow—she recently optimized a legacy API to handle 5x the traffic with minimal latency, which was critical for a client’s real-time analytics dashboard. Web performance optimization is another strength; her refactoring of a complex dashboard cut load times by 30% without sacrificing features.  

Soft skills-wise, Petra excels at translating technical decisions into stakeholder buy-in. During a high-stakes migration project, she managed cross-functional alignment without escalating conflicts, ensuring timelines stayed intact. She also spearheads test automation, ensuring our codebases meet rigorous quality standards.  

Petra’s mentorship has shaped junior engineers’ approaches to best practices, and her ability to balance depth with clarity makes her a natural collaborator. She’s someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives results, and uplifts those around her. I’d wholeheartedly recommend her for any role requiring technical excellence and collaborative leadership.
